text.en:
Item (six), paragraph (aj), for the Mountain Province, Title B, Section One, page two hundred sixty-eight, of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred is amended to read as follows:
"(6) Sagada Poblacion Road—Completion ₱15,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
